now: triage reliable on headers plus a rule; send, book, and pay denied

triage.trigger: A mailbox or thread list is present and a triage rule is stated; quiet when no rule exists or the ask is to reply.
triage.doneWhen: One program reads the triage log and the header list. Exits 0 only if: a header-scan entry precedes every open entry; the set of opened thread ids equals the set of rule-marked ids (symmetric difference 0, printed "opened: N/N"); each opened id has a rule id and a non-empty why-opened line; the reply/send call count in the log is 0. 0/0 is valid.
triage.forbidden: Opening a thread the rule did not mark, opening before the header scan, or replying while triaging.

draft.trigger: Exactly one thread id is named and a reply is wanted; quiet for send or multiple threads.
draft.doneWhen: Program greps the draft's quoted ask line in the named thread's message text at the cited message locator (quote: msg N, line L); exits 0 only if the quote is verbatim there. No thread or no ask yields "no draft: unsupported", which is valid.
draft.forbidden: Sending, replying, or forwarding the draft, or answering a question the thread never asked.
draft.gate: ABSENT send, reply, forward (prepare the draft text and stop; a person sends)

brief.trigger: Calendar events with start and end times for a stated window are present; quiet when only prose exists.
brief.doneWhen: Program computes every pair of calendar events with startA < endB and startB < endA from the structured times and prints the list (overlaps: N/N); the brief's list equals that list and names both events of each pair. Back-to-back (endA == startB) is excluded. 0/0 is valid. No calendar times means unread.
brief.forbidden: Calling a back-to-back or near-miss a conflict, or naming an overlap from prose without calendar times.

pack.trigger: A meeting and source threads or documents are present; quiet when no source is attached.
pack.doneWhen: One program, per item: the source id is unique across items (duplicate source ids = 0, one item per source) and the verbatim quote with locator greps in that source (items: N/N sourced). Unsourced items are dropped; an empty agenda is valid.
pack.forbidden: Adding an agenda item from memory alone, two items from one source, or paraphrasing a source into a quote it does not contain.

book.trigger: A booking is wanted (travel, appointment, reservation, event); always gated, prepare details and stop.
book.doneWhen: Bash:jq -e exits 0 on one JSON file holding the sheet and two calendar-event snapshots: sheet has non-empty what, who, when, where, price, source_link and booked false; events_before equals events_after (state unchanged, no booking made).
book.forbidden: Creating the event or reservation, submitting a booking form, or reporting a booking as done.
book.gate: ABSENT book, calendar create_event (prepare the booking sheet, stop; a person books)

pay.trigger: A payment is wanted (bill, invoice, fee, purchase); always gated, prepare details and stop.
pay.doneWhen: Bash:jq -e exits 0 on one JSON file holding the sheet and the action log: sheet has non-empty payee, amount, due_date, source_document and paid false; action_log has no entry with a verb in pay, payment, checkout, purchase (state unchanged, no payment made).
pay.forbidden: Submitting a payment, entering card or account numbers, checking out, or reporting a payment as made.
pay.gate: ABSENT pay, payment, checkout (prepare the payment sheet, stop; a person pays)
